exposure: health programmes which aimed at preventing women and children from being trapped in or returning to poverty because of illness
cohort: Women and children in Yunnan, China
finding: Health programs in Yunnan, China, successfully narrowed the disparities in maternal and child health outcomes between poor and non-poor areas.
mod_finding: Health programs in Yunnan, China led to increased utilization of facility births and cesarean sections, narrowing the gap between poor and non-poor areas.
